name: Seismic design — base isolation, dampers, structural monitoring
description: Decouple structure from ground motion using laminated rubber/lead-rubber/friction-pendulum bearings and dissipate energy; monitored by robotic total stations, GNSS and geotechnical sensors.

specifications.basis: Bridgestone products page: HDR uses high damping rubber (spring + damping); LRB lead plug in laminated natural rubber (G0.40) with elasto-plastic hysteresis; NRB low damping about 2–3% with G0.30/G0.35/G0.40/G0.45; Elastic Sliding Bearing uses PTFE + stainless plate, used with NRB/LRB/HDR
specifications.value: HDR / LRB / NRB / Elastic Sliding Bearing
